html:
After many years, Quang Phu Cau incense village has preserved the traditional incense making profession. Currently, this place is a tourist attraction that many domestic and international tourists visit.

Located about 40km from Hanoi, Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is a destination that attracts tourists to visit and take photos. Because it is not far from the capital, this place is very convenient for tourists to travel, so the incense village is even more bustling, especially on holidays or at the end of the year.

Currently, Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is hundreds of years old. If visitors come here on sunny days, they will encounter the ways of drying incense, which is a very important step in incense production.

According to local people, incense production facilities are produced all year round, but on holidays, the atmosphere becomes even more bustling.

Visitors will experience drying incense with the locals here, with round, evenly colored incense bundles arranged in a very eye-catching manner.

Many tourists know about Quang Phu Cau incense village through social networks, because many tourists come here to visit and take pictures on social networks, from which the incense village is more widely known, and many tourists from near and far come to visit.

Coming to the incense village, visitors can wear ao dai and take pictures next to the incense village, with incense bundles arranged in shapes that look like flowers, this is the outfit chosen by many tourists when traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense village.

Especially when traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense village on clear blue days, visitors can take beautiful pictures, especially foreign tourists really like this check-in point.

The ingredients for making incense are carefully selected by the locals from herbs such as: Agarwood, pine, rosewood, angelica, patchouli, cinnamon…

Many production facilities also arrange incense bundles in the shape of flowers, S-shapes, 5-pointed stars with many symbols of holidays, to serve the photography tastes of tourists when visiting Quang Phu Cau incense village.
